jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
We are looking for a Channel Manager – Middle East & Africa (MEA) to build, activate and grow Freshworks’ partner ecosystem across the region.

This role is responsible for creating incremental business through the partner ecosystem — identifying the right partners, enabling them to sell and deliver Freshworks solutions, building joint go-to-market motions, generating qualified pipeline and ensuring strong execution across the partner lifecycle.

The role requires a strong balance of commercial ownership, partner management, sales alignment and operational discipline.

The Channel Manager will work closely with Sales, Solution Consulting, Customer Success, Marketing, Alliances and other cross-functional teams to make partners a meaningful growth channel for Freshworks.

. Partner Strategy & Business Development

  • Develop and execute the partner strategy for assigned markets and segments across MEA.
  • Identify and recruit partners that can provide meaningful customer access, technical capability, industry expertise or geographic coverage.
  • Evaluate partners based on their ability to generate pipeline, influence customers, implement solutions and build a sustainable Freshworks practice.
  • Develop joint business plans with priority partners, including revenue objectives, target accounts, GTM activities and capability-building priorities.
  • Build relationships with senior stakeholders within the partner organization and establish clear mutual accountability.

2. Partner Activation & Readiness

  • Own the activation of newly recruited partners and move them from onboarding to productive engagement.
  • Drive partner readiness across product knowledge, sales capability, solution positioning, certifications and implementation capability.
  • Identify capability gaps and create focused enablement plans rather than relying on generic training.
  • Establish measurable activation milestones and monitor progress against them.
  • Ensure partners have the tools, knowledge and internal champions required to independently position and sell Freshworks.

3. Pipeline Generation & Revenue Growth

  • Own partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline generation for the assigned territory.
  • Build joint campaigns, account-mapping exercises, workshops, roundtables and other pipeline-generation initiatives with priority partners.
  • Identify opportunities where partner access or capability can create incremental Freshworks revenue.
  • Work with Sales teams to convert partner-generated pipeline into qualified opportunities and closed business.
  • Track partner contribution across the funnel — from recruitment and activation through pipeline, conversion and revenue.
  • Identify gaps early and build corrective action plans with partners and internal stakeholders.

4. Joint GTM & Field Alignment

  • Build strong relationships with Freshworks Account Executives and Sales leadership to align partner activity with territory priorities.
  • Facilitate joint account planning between Freshworks and partners.
  • Bring partners into relevant enterprise opportunities where they add customer access, technical expertise, implementation capability or commercial leverage.
  • Ensure the right level of partner involvement based on the opportunity rather than involving partners purely for attribution.
  • Support strategic partner-led and partner-assisted opportunities through the sales cycle.

5. Partner Governance & Performance Management

  • Establish regular operating cadences with priority partners, including pipeline reviews, business reviews and action tracking.
  • Maintain visibility into partner performance, pipeline quality, conversion, activity and readiness.
  • Hold partners accountable to agreed commitments and follow through on action items.
  • Identify underperforming or inactive partners and develop clear activation, remediation or rationalization plans.
  • Maintain accurate partner and opportunity information across Freshworks systems and reporting mechanisms.

6. Opportunity & Deal Support

  • Support partner registration, opportunity alignment, attribution and commercial processes in accordance with Freshworks policies.
  • Ensure partner involvement and contribution are clearly documented.
  • Coordinate with Sales, Finance, Legal, Operations and other teams where partner-related issues affect deal execution.
  • Escalate partner-related blockers appropriately and drive them to resolution.
  • Protect a consistent customer experience while ensuring the partner receives the appropriate support.

7. Cross-Functional Collaboration

Work closely with:

  • Sales / Account Executives: account planning, opportunity creation and conversion
  • Solution Consulting: technical readiness, demos and solution positioning
  • Customer Success: expansion, adoption and partner-supported customer outcomes
  • Marketing: campaigns, events, demand generation and partner marketing
  • Partner Enablement: certifications and capability development
  • Operations / Finance: commercial processes, attribution and operational execution
  • Leadership: partner strategy, performance reviews and regional priorities

Role Boundaries

The Channel Manager is accountable for partner growth, activation, engagement and partner-led pipeline to ensure larger market share.

Success Measures

Success in this role will be measured through a combination of partner productivity, pipeline creation, revenue contribution and ecosystem health, including:

  • Partner addition and activation
  • Partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline
  • Partner-attributed revenue / ARR
  • Partner pipeline conversion
  • Revenue/Quality of activated partners
  • Partner readiness and certification
  • Joint account-planning coverage
  • Partner-led GTM activity and resulting pipeline
  • Strategic partner engagement and business-plan execution
  • Partner productivity and contribution to regional growth
  • Accuracy of partner attribution and opportunity governance

The focus is on productive partners and measurable business outcomes, not simply the number of partners recruited.

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
• 7+ years of experience in channel sales, alliances, partner management, indirect sales or B2B technology sales.
  • Experience working with partners such as SIs, MSPs, VARs, distributors, cloud partners or technology specialists.
  • Experience managing enterprise technology sales cycles and partner-led opportunities.
  • Experience working across multiple countries or markets is strongly preferred.
  • Experience in SaaS, ITSM, ITOM, ITAM, cybersecurity, cloud or adjacent enterprise technology categories is an advantage.

Skills

  • Strong commercial and business-development mindset.
  • Ability to build trusted relationships with both partners and internal sales teams.
  • Strong understanding of indirect sales and partner economics.
  • Ability to identify where a partner can create genuine incremental value.
  • Strong pipeline-management and forecasting discipline.
  • Excellent communication, presentation and negotiation skills.
  • Ability to influence cross-functional teams without direct authority.
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-moving, matrixed environment.
  • Strong analytical skills and ability to use data to manage partner performance.
